subject: 2553 (July 1999) page 1 item 6, the fourth (branch-code) group of the TIN comb chain: the printed box x 172.08-205.44, y 189.36-208.80 pt (top-left origin) in the pinned source 42792553.pdf sha256 e52f96fe48aba2890078f889930744a4e13a4defe1284aa9c5292e2c702a20e5. BIR's own field key for it is frm2553:txtBranchCode. The cell id p1c24 is a HINT only: cell ids are quantised bounding boxes and renumber on any geometry change, so the printed box is what identifies the subject and the edit anchor below is what binds it to a batch.
what: The whole TIN strip — four groups plus the three separator boxes between them — keeps the same outer span 57.84-205.44 pt (147.6pt). Separator widths are unchanged (they only move). The remaining 133.48pt is split equally across 14 digit cells (3+3+3+5) by left(i)=round(i*width/14, 2). p1c18 left 57.84 width 28.6 (3 x 9.53, 9.54, 9.53); p1c20 left 91.24 width 28.61 (3 x 9.54, 9.53, 9.54); p1c22 left 124.37 width 28.6 (3 x 9.53, 9.53, 9.54); p1c24 left 157.77 width 47.67 (5 x 9.53, 9.54, 9.53, 9.54, 9.53). A white knockout covers that same outer rectangle so the official 3- or 4-cell artwork does not show through the new even cells. Each digit group keeps ONE outer 0.72pt frame; interior slot dividers are short bottom hairs (~33% of slot height), matching how the official sheet draws a charbox tick (2550M item-1 month v172 is 0.72×4.32pt in a 13.20pt box), not a full-height wall on every digit. Separator boxes keep their dedicated SVG fill and a 0.72pt black frame, and stay non-tabbable. The branch group p1c24 is five EDITABLE cells (one blank maxlength-1 input each, no value, no readonly), because the official artwork prints an EMPTY branch box — no 000, no ink of any kind inside it. Painting a locked 00000 over a blank official box would silently declare the head office on a sheet whose filer has to name a real branch. First/last writing-surface insets are not re-applied: even cell width across the strip is the layout rule. Branch pitch 9.53.
reason: BIR's July-1999 artwork for 2553 is CORRECT and OUT OF DATE. Measured from the pinned PDF, the branch box prints exactly two internal ticks, at x 182.88 and x 194.16, each 3.12pt tall at the foot of the box (y 204.72-207.84) and stroked 0.72pt -- three compartments. Unlike 2550M, 2553 pre-prints NOTHING inside that box: the box is empty of both glyphs and vector ink, so a filer sees three blank compartments and no default 000. BIR's own eBIRForms client, whose runtime this repository has harvested, declares that same field with max_length 5. No rule can derive 'BIR widened this field after 1999' from 1999 ink, which is exactly why this is a stage-2 correction and not a stage-1 producer bug. Filing safety: a branch code is what tells the Bureau WHICH establishment a percentage-tax return belongs to. A filer whose branch code has four or five digits cannot enter it on today's form at all, so the return files against the head office and the branch that incurred the liability files nothing. Corpus context, measured from the pinned PDFs on 2026-08-08: of 53 bundles, 39 print 3+3+3+5, three print 3+3+3+3 (2550M 2007, 2551M 2002, 2553 1999), one prints 3+3+3+4 (1600WP 2010) and ten are not measurable by that method. 2553 is one of the three; 2550M is corrected by C01 and each of the others needs its own record.
authority: BIR eBIRForms HTA runtime declaration (harvested), regulation not identified in-repo. rules/forms/2553-v1999/fields.json declares field_key frm2553:txtBranchCode with constraints.max_length = 5, confidence "high", source_refs ["official-hta-runtime#saveXML", "official-hta-runtime#control:L428", "revision-matched-final-copy-keys"]; the same file declares frm2553:txtTIN1 / txtTIN2 / txtTIN3 with max_length 3 each (official-hta-runtime#control:L425 / L426 / L427), all four carrying item_number "6" and page 1, so the 3-3-3 part of the chain is agreed and only the branch code is not. NO BIR issuance is cited because none could be identified from anything in this checkout; that gap is stated deliberately rather than filled with a plausible-looking regulation number, and it stays visible until someone supplies the real one.

None of the three may be allowlisted, excluded or waived to make this correction quiet, and no tolerance moves for it.
verified_by: An independent producer, sharing nothing with whatever writes the correction: the three printed compartments are re-derived from the pinned PDF by a reader that is not extract.py (re-derived while authoring this record by `mutool draw -F trace` and by Poppler `pdftocairo -svg`, both agreeing with PyMuPDF to 0.01pt on the box 172.08-205.44 x 189.36-208.80 and the two ticks 182.88 / 194.16), and the five emitted compartments are re-derived from the written bytes by a parser that reads none of emit.py's markers. Not from build/layout, not from the IR, not from the applier's own manifest, and not from a determinism re-run -- that runs the writer twice and both halves drift together.
